title: Mobs hear noise and investigate
description: Hostile mobs hear footsteps, blocks, doors, fights and explosions through walls and walk to where the sound came from.

title: Noise, light and scent stealth HUD
description: Optional client HUD showing your current noise, light exposure, voice activity and wounded blood trail.

title: Admin debug sound traces (/mobsenses debug)
description: Operators can turn on particle traces showing how sounds, light and scent reach nearby mobs.

title: Per-world presets and /mobsenses status
description: Configure presets (Off, Subtle, Default, Hardcore), multipliers and per-world settings live in-game.
